Madhvendra Pratap Sharma is one of India's brightest young talents. Born in 2013, this 13-year-old from Madhya Pradesh is the 2nd seed at the Under-15 National Championships 2026 happening in Hyderabad, Telangana. We bring you his round 1 game from the event against Kartikeya Ishanth Bandi (1641). Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
Video: ChessBase India
